Eye Pattern - Black Sclera.description:
👁️ Eye Pattern: Black Sclera
The whites of the eyes are black instead of white — a striking, inhuman look that makes the iris color stand out sharply.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Eye Pattern - Black Sclera.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Both eyes have entirely black sclera — the whites of the eyes are fully black — with the colored irises standing out against that dark surround. Apply black sclera using selected iris colors. Do not turn this into active power use.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
